description: Fork of exp321 (separate qk+v with RoPE, current LUT-LM SOTA 1.5933 @ 8K) replacing qk_joint + v_lut with a single joint qkv LUT at NAP=6, tph=512 (wider not deeper). Single TinyMHL per layer produces q (idx 0:d_qk), k (d_qk:2*d_qk), v (2*d_qk:2*d_qk+d_v); RoPE on q,k pre-SDPA. Per-layer qkv params: 12.6M+12.6M=25.2M (separate) -> 3072*64*160 = 31.5M (joint t=512); 6 layers 151M -> 189M; total model 602M -> ~640M. Wide-not-deep counterpart to exp322 (joint t=256, NAP=6, 545M, +0.02 bpb behind exp321 at step 3400). Tests if doubling tph at NAP=6 recovers per-(q,k,v)-stream resolution lost by sharing tables.
